sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing: Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation notice
sources.quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to Gemini 3.8 Flash (`gemini-3.8-flash`) and be billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing: Gemini 2.5 Flash deprecation notice
sources.quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-flash` will automatically route to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`)

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, November 2, 2026 (Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash deprecation)
sources.quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to `gemini-3.8-flash` and be billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates. ... all API requests to `gemini-2.5-flash` will automatically route to `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` and be billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, October 13, 2026 (Gemini 4 Argon GA)
sources.quote: Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`) generally available (GA): Released Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`), our most capable model built for complex coding, agentic, math, and science tasks.

sources.title: What's new in Gemini 4 Argon: Pricing
sources.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is available at introductory pricing through November 30, 2026: Input tokens: $2.00 per 1M tokens ($4.00 starting December 1, 2026) Cached input tokens: Implicit caching discounts cached input by 95%, to $0.10 per 1M tokens ($0.20 starting December 1, 2026). Output tokens, including thinking tokens: $10.00 per 1M tokens ($20.00 starting December 1, 2026)

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, September 2, 2026 (Gemini 3.8 Flash GA)
sources.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available (GA): Released `gemini-3.8-flash`, our most intelligent Flash model

sources.title: What's new in Gemini 3.8 Flash: introductory pricing
sources.quote: Introductory pricing: Gemini 3.8 Flash is available at an introductory rate of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens through December 31, 2026. Standard pricing of $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens takes effect January 1, 2027.

sources.title: What's new in Gemini 3.8 Flash: Pricing (Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.6 Flash)
sources.quote: Take advantage of introductory pricing across Google AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform through December 31, 2026 for Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.6 Flash. Standard pricing takes effect January 1, 2027.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, July 21, 2026 (Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite GA)
sources.quote: Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite generally available (GA): Released stable, production-ready versions of our latest 3.x Flash models

sources.title: What's new in Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite: New models table (launch prices)
sources.quote: | Gemini 3.6 Flash | `gemini-3.6-flash` | `medium` | $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens | ... | Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite | `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` | `minimal` | $0.30/1M input tokens and $2.50/1M output tokens |

sources.title: Gemini API: Context caching (implicit caching)
sources.quote: Implicit caching is enabled by default for all Gemini 2.5 and newer models. ... We automatically pass on cost savings if your request hits caches.

sources.title: Gemini API: Context caching (explicit caching support)
sources.quote: Explicit caching (manually creating and managing cache objects) is not supported in the Interactions API, or for Gemini 4 Argon and onward.
